name: fetch_option_quote
description: Fetch a snapshot quote (bid, ask, IV, greeks) for a single option contract. Read-only. Use fetch_option_chain first to discover valid expirations and strikes.

expiry.description: Expiration date in YYYYMMDD form, e.g. "20260918".

tick_types.description: Optional. Comma-separated IBKR generic tick codes. Defaults to the full superset (option vol/OI/IV, historical vol, RT volume, shortable, fundamental ratios, dividends, etc.) — TWS silently omits ticks that don't apply to the contract type, so requesting the union is free. Pass a narrower string like "100,101,106" if you only want specific fields.
